decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already establishes RR-01 in the internal-page header content; the footer-specific update requires no additional candidate change.
Changing the footer report identifier to RR-01 does not alter the final-page warning's presence, visual treatment, or confidentiality message.
The existing same-message MODIFY already requires RR-01 throughout the RR01 report, which encompasses the footer identifier.
The fixed footer identifier does not change which customer-specific fields are editable or how assessment-date and vehicle fields are displayed.
The footer identifier change does not alter the front-page score dashboard, its heading, displayed result fields, or prominence.
The footer identifier change does not affect the content or scannable presentation of the front-page result explanation.
Using RR-01 in the footer is a specific identifier correction and does not change the candidate's broader premium visual-style requirements.
The report identifier correction does not change the required fonts, icons, or reusable design assets.
The footer identifier correction does not change the required report variants, source editability, export support, or format selection.
Correcting the RR01 footer identifier does not alter the score-to-variant, risk-band, or exposure-level mapping rule.
